summary: Exports must surface local-mirror iterator failures and decode binary response envelopes before writing native files.
reason: SQLite can report errors only after row iteration, and the shared client wraps binary HTTP bodies in base64 JSON; ignoring either contract can silently produce incomplete or invalid exports.
validated_outcome: Iterator failures stop export, and native FIT bytes round-trip through the client envelope; focused tests plus Go test, vet, and build pass.
